title: Packi: evaluation harness, test sequences and run records for online 3D bin packing with LLMs
description: Evaluation code and data for the paper 'Packi: Robotic 3D Bin Packing With Large Language Models Fine-Tuned by Learning From Demonstration' (Journal of Robotics, under revision): the headless evaluation harness, the fixed test sequences of all benchmarks, every run record behind the paper's tables, and the scripts that generate the tables and figures. Trained models: https://huggingface.co/kasramojallal. Companion repository (demonstrations and training): https://github.com/kasramojallal1/learning-from-demonstration.

creators.name: Mojallal, Kasra
creators.affiliation: Department of Mechanical, Automotive and Materials Engineering, University of Windsor
